codex.plugin.title: Codex
codex.plugin.summary: Lets project and task owners run their sessions in Codex on this computer, with your own Codex configuration and login. Messages, tool calls and usage all land in ergo's session; you can also take over Codex sessions already on this computer and hand them back.
codex.plugin.notInstalled: Codex isn't installed. Install it with npm i -g @openai/codex, then sign in with codex login. Come back here and enable it afterwards; everything else keeps working.
codex.plugin.unknownVersion: Found Codex but couldn't tell its version: {min} or newer is needed. Update with npm i -g @openai/codex, then sign in with codex login.
codex.plugin.tooOld: Codex on this computer is {version}, which is too old: {min} or newer is needed. Update with npm i -g @openai/codex.
codex.runtime.title: Codex
codex.settings.sandboxMode.workspace-wri: Write in the working folder only
codex.tools.followupTask: Give a subagent more to do
codex.sessions.label: Reading Codex sessions on this computer
codex.sessions.busyLoaded: This session is open (another Codex process is writing to it)
codex.sessions.busyRecent: Active {minutes} min ago, so it may still be open
codex.sessions.unsure: The list can't tell whether it's still open. It may be: close it there first, or take over a fork
codex.child.usageLimit: Codex is out of quota (or rate limited): {detail}. Send another message once the quota is back to carry on.
codex.child.notLoggedIn: Codex isn't signed in: run codex login in a terminal, then send another message to carry on.
codex.child.modelUnavailable: Codex can't use the current model: {detail} Pick another model in ⚙, then send another message to carry on. To stop having to pick one, change Codex's own settings (model in config.toml).
codex.child.hookNotActive: ergo's guard hook isn't active in Codex (status: {status}), and Codex can't run without the guard. Check the Codex version and configuration (the hooks feature may be turned off).
codex.child.noSession: This Codex session hasn't started yet, so there's nothing to write
codex.child.handoffTimeout: The handoff summary took longer than {seconds} seconds, so it was abandoned
codex.child.handoffInterrupted: Writing the handoff summary was interrupted
codex.child.handoffEmpty: Codex didn't write a handoff summary
codex.child.noResult: The turn ended before this call got a result
codex.child.threadBusy: This Codex session is still open (a terminal or another program is writing to it), and Codex won't let a second process write. Close it there first, or take over a fork.
codex.navigate.noInput: There's no record of this message being given to Codex (from before the takeover, or it never went to Codex), so it can't roll back past it
codex.navigate.noCallPoint: Codex can only roll back to before a message, not around a tool call (start of a stage or step)
codex.navigate.ownSummary: Codex doesn't write branch summaries itself (ergo has to write one and pass it in)
codex.doctor.program.title: Program and version
codex.doctor.program.gone: Codex can't be found on this computer anymore (it was there at startup): tasks and projects using it won't start
codex.doctor.program.noVersion: Found Codex, but can't tell its version ({min} or newer needed)
codex.doctor.program.tooOld: Codex on this computer is now {version}, too old: {min} or newer is needed, and tasks and projects using it won't run
codex.doctor.program.fixInstall: Reinstall it with npm i -g @openai/codex (codex has to be on PATH), sign in with codex login, then restart Ergo
codex.doctor.program.fixUpdate: Update it with npm i -g @openai/codex, then restart Ergo
